verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents bulk transfer between Google Authenticator instances: you create a QR code on the old device and scan it on the new one. Nothing shows the app importing tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps. Community comments on the multi-account export QR concern moving codes out of Google Authenticator, not bringing other apps' tokens in, so this is an adjacent device-migration feature rather than cross-app import.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
